summary: Wallet Orders is a server-side web service that Apple Wallet calls to track orders and push updates to a user's device. It needs Apple Wallet and Apple Pay, and BifrOSt has neither, so there is no counterpart to build.

features.apple: Order, creating the source for an order, building a distributable order package
features.note: Order packages are signed for Wallet; no BifrOSt equivalent

features.apple: Retrieve the registrations for a device, Retrieve the latest version of an order
features.note: Web service endpoints the Wallet app calls on the merchant's server

features.apple: Register a device for update notifications, Unregister a device from update notifications, PushToken
features.note: APNs push tokens; BifrOSt has no APNs
Log upload from Wallet to the merchant server
